obernants.approximation_semantics: Conditional mathematical model with bounded correspondence evidence, not a formal proof.
obernants.assumptions: Standard Rust arithmetic and trustworthy independent oracle; resource assumptions stated in the model.
obernants.domain: 9,409 bounded pairs (0..=96 squared), 49 extremal pairs, explicit zero conventions, consecutive Fibonacci pairs up to u64 overflow, and 4,096 deterministic full-width pairs. Three additional tests exercise 20 affine alternatives across five input pairs including zeros/ties, four divisor lattices and 20 bounded linear-solvability searches, five independent residue scans and one full-width u128 inverse check. The coefficient-policy counterexample rejects a valid alternate certificate; modulus/product premises are explicit.
obernants.operator: Let F be the declared finite fixtures and U be terminating candidate implementations paired with pass/fail. R(P,pass) iff all assertions hold, and R(P,fail) iff some assertion fails or execution panics. U minus R consists of false pass/fail observations. Harness abort/nontermination is excluded.

obernants.operator: A pass reconstructs every implementation satisfying all fixtures, with arbitrary off-fixture behavior. A failure reconstructs implementations or faulty oracle assumptions causing the observed mismatch; it does not uniquely identify the defect.
